remarks: Turnkey One-Bedroom Condo in Prime Stamford Location. Move right into this immaculate and updated one-bedroom condo located in a desirable, secured building in Stamford. Featuring stylish crown molding and rich wood flooring throughout, this home is packed with high-end finishes and thoughtful touches. The modern kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances and elegant quartz countertops, while the updated bathrooms include a luxurious jacuzzi tub in the primary bath - perfect for unwinding after a long day. Enjoy peaceful mornings or relaxing evenings on your private balcony, accessed from the quiet, rear-facing living room. Parking is convenient with one oversized, assigned underground space and an additional unassigned space on the main level. The building is pet-friendly and offers outstanding amenities including a pristine fitness center and private his-and-her saunas in the locker rooms. Conveniently located just moments from Ridgeway Shopping Center, downtown Stamford's theatres, restaurants, and shopping, as well as Metro North, I-95, Merritt Parkway and beautiful Scalzi Park - complete with walking paths, bocce courts, a skate park, and a playground. This condo truly has it all - modern comfort, great amenities, and an unbeatable location. HIGHEST & BEST BY WEDNESDAY 6/4 AT 3:00PM
